messages:
ana: Quick heads-up 20: legal signed off on the public deprecation timeline for v1 -> v2. We need a focused migration guide, sample fixes, and redirect rules. Target publish Thu 09:00 UTC.
kevin: on it. I'll run a cross-repo search for /v1/ calls and hardcoded legacy model ids and post a short CSV with file:path:line.
rui: flag: a few models changed their default temperature and embedding dims during the alias swap. We should call that out in the guide so customers don't see small-quality diffs and think it's a regression.
zoe: good catch. I'll add a "what might change" section listing: default temp diffs, embed length changes, and tokenization edgecases.
nana: (typo)
nana: :grimacing: meant ana.
kevin: I found 37 /v1 calls across docs and samples; 9 examples in mobile SDKs use positional args. I'll open PRs with fixes and add a short compatibility snippet in the guide labeled "temporary shim 00ms".
rui: please also check any Go examples - we recently added a Go SDK and the snippets used mixed positional/content parameters. We need to show the explicit payload in the migration guide for Go too.
zoe: building out a short compatibility shim for docs (JS/Py/Go) that demonstrates mapping old calls to the new explicit payload shape. Example (Go):```go
// docs-only shim - temporary
func Normalize(req interface{}) map[string]interface{} {
  switch r := req.(type) {
  case []string:
    return map[string]interface{}{"input": r}
  case map[string]interface{}:
    if _, ok := r["input"]; !ok {
      if c, ok2 := r["content"]; ok2 { r["input"] = c }
    }
    return r
  default:
    return map[string]interface{}{"input": req}
  }
}
```
kevin: perfect. I'll avoid recommending shims in customer copy and mark them clearly as docs-only.
zoe: redirect map draft: /models/legacy-dialogue -> dialogue-stable-v2, /models/old-embed -> embed-1024-v2. Pushed a WIP to internal/redirects.md.
rui: QA: I'll add a docs CI smoke job that runs a canonical snippet matrix across staging-v1 + staging-v2 to compare: response shape, embed vector length, and stream continuity. If mismatch rate > 2% we hold.
nana: (still me :))
kevin: PRs opened: redwood/docs#8123 (migration guide + compatibility examples), redwood/sample-next#307 (env + snippet fixes), redwood/sample-go#14 (Go snippet updates). docs-bot: CI pending.
zoe: also add a small section for Dedicated customers: how to pin a tenant to a legacy model id and how to request a temporary weight restore from infra. Include a copy-pasteable curl and a short contact template.
rui: smoke run early result: 2/32 snippets flagged - one streaming example timed out, one embed returned 1536 vs expected 1024 (sample assumed old dim). Filing quick fixes.
kevin: fixed the embed expectation in the sample and increased streaming timeout in tutorial. Pushed patches; CI rerunning.
docs-bot: redwood/docs#8123 updated by @kevin - "fix streaming timeout and go snippet" (CI: running).
zoe: small UX note: console banner should link to migration guide and the redirect status page. I'll file the banner PR after docs merge. Banner copy must be generic - do not expose internal alias strings.
rui: also adding a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: "embeddings shorter or longer than before" with steps: (1) check model alias mapping in console, (2) verify vector dim, (3) re-index vectors if needed, (4) contact support with sample vector lengths.
kevin: CI green for docs PR and sample-next. sample-go PR pending one minor lint. docs-bot: CI passes and smoke-matrix reports 31/32 passed after fixes.
nana: hehe naming is hard :)
kevin: owners: migration guide (kevin), sample fixes (kevin + zoe), Go snippets (zoe), redirects (zoe), smoke CI (rui). Add owners to each PR description.
zoe: small localization ask: partner-facing one-pager will need quick translation for es/fr/de. I'll queue i18n once the English page is final.
rui: final step: once all PRs merged, schedule redirect deploy and banner at Thu 09:00 UTC. If smoke-matrix post-deploy shows >1% failures, roll back redirects and open incident.
kevin: merged to staging; planning to merge to prod at 08:30 UTC so we can monitor for 30min before sending emails.
docs-bot: redwood/docs#8123 merged to staging. docs-bot: smoke-matrix job scheduled nightly during rollout.
zoe: thanks team. Please log any customer regressions under tag "deprecation-rollout" and escalate to infra if related to weight pinning.
kevin: merging to prod at 08:30 UTC. If anyone sees weirdness, ping #incidents and tag me.
rui: running final smoke checks now. Early green.
kevin: great. I'll coordinate banner + redirect deploy at 09:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.
